group.title: An inventory-dashboard webinar
group.titleZh: 庫存儀表板線上說明會
group.passage: Hello, everyone, and welcome to this webinar on our updated inventory dashboard. Today's session focuses on setting stock alerts and exporting weekly summaries. The purchasing module will be covered in a separate session next month. You can enter questions in the chat at any time, and we will answer them after the demonstration. If the screen looks blurry, choose a higher video quality in your player settings; there is no need to restart the application. A recording and a practice data file will be emailed to registered participants tomorrow. Please use the sample data rather than uploading confidential company records.
group.passageZh: 大家好，歡迎參加新版庫存儀表板的線上說明會。今天著重在設定庫存警示，以及匯出每週摘要。採購模組會在下個月另一場說明會介紹。各位隨時可以在聊天室輸入問題，我們會在示範後回答。如果畫面模糊，請在播放器設定選擇較高畫質，不需要重新啟動應用程式。錄影和練習資料檔會在明天以電子郵件寄給已報名者。請使用範例資料，不要上傳公司的機密紀錄。
